voice_line: Voice: if the Slovak names an agent in the nominative and the learner sentence moves that agent out of subject position or drops it (an active Slovak sentence turned into an English passive), that is SAME, provided the meaning is preserved. Where the Slovak is itself impersonal or passive, an English passive is SAME.

calls.caveat: billed versus free-tier is NOT detectable from the response body; these are list-price figures for the tokens the API reported.
